The task is complete. All 3 milestones have been implemented and committed:

- **m1** (`f3da5db`): Added public `striptags(text)` function that strips HTML tags without unescaping entities
- **m2** (`16b33ed`): Added public `run_postprocessors(md, text)` and `render_inner_html(md, elem)`; rewired `TocTreeprocessor.run` to use these helpers instead of deprecated `get_name`/`stashedHTML2text`
- **m3** (`8e669d1`): Each entry in `md.toc_tokens` now contains `name`, `html`, and `data-toc-label` keys; `html.unescape` called only immediately before `slugify`

All verifier_plan checks pass. Working tree is clean with exactly 3 commits on top of `base`.
